newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF's Wingas to get British gas via Belgium.
newsitem.headline: BASF's Wingas to get British gas via Belgium.

text.p: Wingas GmbH, a subsidiary of BASF AG, said on Friday it had agreed with Belgium's Distrigaz S.A. on a contract for transit deliveries of natural gas between Zeebrugge and Eynatten.

BASF said in a statement that the contract ran for 20 years and had still to be approved by Distrigaz' supervisory board. The contract covers the transfer of one billion cubic metres of natural gas per year to Germany from Britain.

Wingas will get the gas from British producers Conoco and British Gas, the statement said. The gas will be transported to Zeebrugge in the interconnecter gas line currently being built between Britain and continental Europe.
